title: We launched a Pine Script strategy optimizer — finds the best inputs automatically
author: vitaliy3commas
selftext:
Hey traders!

We've been building an optimizer for TradingView Pine Script strategies. You point it at a strategy and it scans the input space to find the parameter sets that actually hold up — instead of you manually tweaking length, source, timeframe one by one.

The part we're most focused on is robustness: not just picking the inputs with the highest backtest return (which usually overfit), but finding parameter regions that stay stable, so the result isn't just curve-fit to past data.

Works on your own strategies, and you can rank results by robustness score, win rate, profit, or drawdown.

Disclosure: we're the team behind it — [https://quantpilot.com](https://quantpilot.com/). Happy to answer questions about how the optimization or the robustness scoring works.

comments.author: turk-fx
comments.body: What is the point of this? I can ask this exact question to any AI model and it will go find stocks matching the criteria. Dont even need a dashboard or something.

replies.author: vitaliy3commas
replies.body:
Thanks for the question.

The product covers the entire workflow, from research and idea validation to backtesting and optimization.

**Research Agent:** Imagine asking something like, *"If the Fear & Greed Index is below 20 and I buy Bitcoin, what take-profit level has historically been optimal?"* Instead of simply searching the web and returning an article, the Research Agent pulls historical market data (for example, from CoinMarketCap and other sources), analyzes it, and generates dashboards and insights based on actual data.

**Strategy Agent:** If you have a trading idea or an existing strategy, you simply describe it in plain English. The agent builds the strategy, runs a backtest, and shows you the results. If you're happy with the performance, you can finalize it. If not, you can continue iterating and optimizing until you're satisfied.

By the end of August, we'll also launch **strategy execution**, meaning you'll be able to deploy and run your strategies directly from the platform instead of just researching and testing them.
